verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a founder comment that Shortwave uses Gmail's APIs to enable "offline handling." That points to some offline capability of the product itself, but nothing describes what works offline or how changes sync afterward. Missing for 10: documented offline reading, offline search, offline composing/queued sending, sync-on-reconnect behavior, first-party docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: We integrate with Gmail's APIs (not IMAP) to enable faster real-time updates, better latency compensation, offline handling
